effective_steps.description: The matched interleaved pair showed the regression on this workload.
Freezing the margin before the intervals let one interval resolve and the other stay unresolved.

invalid_or_misleading_steps.description: Debug logging was switched on for one capture, so it measured different instrumentation.
Optimization A ran with a 5 s warm-up and a different workload mix, so it could not be compared.
The short-window captures ran 8 s of 300 s under a failed monitor and settle nothing.
The A-then-B captures carry a cold-start decay in the first run.
The closed-loop capture timed from actual send hid a 600 ms stall.
The completion-only p99 left out 5 of 100 started requests.
